questions.question: Which systems will the agent call, who owns each, and where are their docs?
questions.recommended: The order system and the staff task queue, both owned by Harbor Goods; the payment provider behind refunds, an outside service.

questions.question: Which orders can the agent cancel?
questions.recommended: Only orders that have not shipped yet.

questions.question: Lookups may be retried without limit. What ends the retries?
questions.recommended: Three tries, then treat the lookup as unanswered.
